task: FV2-052 — Report native desktop microphone route selection failures
summary: The Windows FlutterWebRTC bridge ignored the result of AudioDeviceModule::SetRecordingDevice and always returned success after a matching device ID. It now reports enumeration and native route-selection failures through MethodChannel so Flutter can roll back the selected device. LiveKit previously cached selectedAudioInput before native confirmation; it now updates the cache only after a successful route change. Flutter displays localized retry guidance and keeps its selection/preferences unchanged on either native failure.

checks.name: Native device selection mapping regression
checks.observation: Matching IDs invoke the native setter with the expected index; a nonzero setter result is reported as failure; missing IDs do not invoke the setter.

checks.name: Flutter active and listener route selection regression suite
checks.observation: Windows and macOS active-track/listener flows invoke the native selection method; simulated native route and enumeration failures preserve LiveKit's previous cached input, roll back UI/preferences, show localized guidance, and do not open another microphone capture. Android/iOS selection and related error paths remain covered.
